title: Topic 6 流行
japanese_text: 小学生の頃、私はいろいろ<u>空想して</u>、漫画を描くことが好きだった。中学生になると、家族たちは<u>くだらない</u>とか、そんな<u>幼稚な</u>ことはやめろと言ってきた。しかし、私は高校でも大学でも漫画を描くことはやめなかった。そして25才のとき、<u>ついに</u>私の描いた漫画が雑誌に<u>載った</u>。
english_translation: When I was in elementary school, I liked to fantasize about all kinds of things and draw manga comics. When I entered junior high school, my family told me it was silly and that I should stop doing such childish things. But I never stopped drawing manga, even in high school and in college. Finally, when I was 25, a magazine published a manga comic that I'd drawn.
